summary: The Crypto Company filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to secured promissory notes with Eksa Holdings LLC, Practivist Investors LLC, Robert Nail, and Three Mile Creek Future LLC. The company issued 234,251,400 common shares—20% of the $1,054,071 aggregate principal, priced at $0.0009 (August 11 close)—in exchange for maturity extensions to August 2027. Noteholders may receive an additional 10% of outstanding principal in shares if principal remains as of May 11, 2027. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exemptions, constituting a direct financial obligation. This is a routine debt restructuring and unregistered equity issuance, not a special situation.
